title: Ribbed Washcloth
description: A simple square that turns back-loop-only practice into a useful textured fabric.
expectationText: A practical swatch-sized project where the ribbing is obvious fast, so the technique clicks before you move on to wearables.

steps.title: Row 1
steps.instruction: Half double crochet in the third chain from the hook and each chain across.

steps.title: Row 2
steps.instruction: Chain 2, turn, and work half double crochet in the back loop only across.

steps.title: Rows 3 to 16
steps.instruction: Continue chaining 2, turning, and working half double crochet in the back loop only across.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Fasten off and weave in both ends neatly.
